title: Distance becomes a functional
promptMarkdown: Let $M$ be a closed linear subspace of a normed space $X$ and $x\notin M$. Put $d=\inf_{m\in M}\|x-m\|$. Show $d>0$ and construct $\varphi\in X^*$ such that $\varphi|_M=0$, $\|\varphi\|=1$, and $\varphi(x)=d$. Explain why closedness matters.
hintLadder: Define a functional that kills $M$ and sends $x$ to the distance; test its norm on $x-m_k$.

criteria.criterion: Uses closedness to obtain positive distance.
